project.title: Dedicated-UID broker namespace prerequisite
project.goal: Refuse unsafe Linux namespace/process metadata while retaining lease/layout and live SQLite locks
project.scope: Namespace guard only; persistent host ownership/closeBUSY/initializer/transports remain required

boundary.responsibility: Linux actual-thread profile, safe ancestry/modes/ACL/sidecars and sticky physical guard
boundary.rationale: Different-UID clients must not acquire new filesystem access or become simultaneous legacy writers
excludes: Prior/inherited/passed descriptors; malicious root or broker UID; owning runtime, fresh bootstrap, endpoints, full platform qualification

scenario.normal.description: Accept strict current profile without data mutation and retain exclusive lease

scenario.given: Offline-provisioned broker0700/0600 named persistent files and actual separate UID processes
scenario.when: Acquire and validate trusted Linux broker namespace
scenario.then: Accept strict current profile without data mutation and retain exclusive lease

scenario.refusal.description: Typed path-free refusal; 132 real access attempts denied across WAL and DELETE

scenario.given: Unsafe UID/mode/ACL/symlink/hardlink/sidecar or actual thread privilege facts
scenario.when: Attempt namespace acquisition or actual different-UID file access
scenario.then: Typed path-free refusal; 132 real access attempts denied across WAL and DELETE

scenario.preservation.description: No ordinary regular-file open/close; SQLite main and WAL writer protocols remain held

scenario.given: Held real SQLite transactions and current safe regular namespace
scenario.when: Read metadata and revalidate namespace/actual handles
scenario.then: No ordinary regular-file open/close; SQLite main and WAL writer protocols remain held

scenario.correction.description: Use actual thread; prior FD stays writable and requires offline provisioning; root is outside hostile-client boundary

scenario.given: Leader and worker NoNewPrivs differ; a client acquired a descriptor before chmod; root poisons WAL sidecar
scenario.when: Check current-thread status and exercise explicit negative controls
scenario.then: Use actual thread; prior FD stays writable and requires offline provisioning; root is outside hostile-client boundary

scenario.concurrent.description: Lease and correct SQLite lock remain; restoration cannot revive retired guard

scenario.given: First broker holds lease and real WAL/DELETE transaction
scenario.when: Second broker/SQLite contender competes; namespace is invalidated then restored
scenario.then: Lease and correct SQLite lock remain; restoration cannot revive retired guard

action.broker_namespace.description: Acquire and observe protected dedicated-UID namespace

output.description: Non-Clone private namespace guard, no writer or schema/adoption authority

errors.refused: Unsupported profile, unsafe broker thread, invalid namespace, busy lease or sticky changed namespace

preconditions: Trusted root/installer and enrolled broker UID, all clients/legacy run separate unprivileged UID
Fresh protected offline provisioning and no pre-opened/inherited/passed client descriptors; guard cannot prove or revoke these
Launcher before threads establishes UID/caps/NoNewPrivs/umask; no regular descriptors for live SQLite in binding phase
postconditions: Wrong metadata/unsupported ACL absence refuses without repair/data write
Every regular live observation uses statat/xattr/read_at/fstat, preserving process lock discipline
Guard retains root lease and layout until dropped; owning host must enforce confirmed SQLite close before drop
external_effects: Acquire and retain kernel directory flock; no namespace/data repair or SQL mutation

boundaries.rationale: Current thread, nofollow metadata, strict ACL support and explicit priorFD/operator limits

concurrency.rationale: Held lease and live SQLite POSIX/WAL lock preservation during no-open validation

authorization.rationale: OS UID/capability/access boundary; neither sameUID nor priorFD revocation is implied

idempotency.rationale: No persistent effects or mutation retries; invalidation remains sticky in memory

atomicity.rationale: No transactions or persistent mutation; namespace snapshots explicitly do not provide atomic lifetime admission

action.broker_namespace.behavior: Validate actual thread privileges and every ancestor, take root lease, stat/check ACL/mode/UID/link/type before regular binding, bind retained layout; revalidate without regular opens and invalidate permanently on any error
